pin.longFormSummary:
A space-themed Prime Value hotel with an Epic Universe walking path, rooms for up to four, a pool and children’s splash area.

Family stay

The hotel opened to its first guests on 2025-01-21 with 750 rooms. Standard rooms have two queen beds and sleep up to four. Confirm the booked room’s occupancy and any connecting-room arrangements for a larger family.

Stella Nova offers a dedicated walking path to Epic Universe as well as shuttle service. The other Universal parks require a longer transfer.

Budget and booking

Universal places this hotel in its Prime Value category. Compare your actual dates, room type and total stay cost; a value category does not guarantee the cheapest available room. Overnight self-parking is listed by Loews at $30 plus tax per vehicle per night, subject to change. Meals and park tickets are separate unless expressly included in your package.

Early Park Admission applies to selected attractions with valid park admission and current operating conditions. A hotel stay here does not include the complimentary Universal Express Unlimited benefit offered at Portofino Bay, Hard Rock and Royal Pacific.

hotel.basis: Opened 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor property snapshot with 126 reviews, Rooms/Service/Location/Cleanliness/Value 4.1/3.8/4.3/4.4/3.8 of 5, rounded to nearest half point. This snapshot may lag live review totals and reflects a smaller early review sample. AAA property inspection checked; component scores are not Diamond counts. MICHELIN Orlando displayed five other hotels and Forbes Travel Guide’s Orlando directory did not identify this property. No current property-specific award verified; acclaim remains null.

reviews.title: Universal Stella Nova Resort Review
reviews.quote: The rooms looked great and were very modern and the outside of the hotel is a spectacle.
